title: Other-years heading, Pick a different date label, message line break

history.detail:
PASS: PASS, gate 1, audit of 71563a7.

Sprint file: read fresh. Unchanged since start (31606bc). The centring quick fix it depends on (f3cccc4) is in the base.

Handoff: read at the audited commit. It has a Round 1 section quoting VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0, with 622 tests.

My own check: npm run verify at 71563a7, on a clean primary checkout. Result: verify=0, VERIFY PASS exit=0, 55 test files and 622 tests passed.

- R1 Met. eventsHeading(events, eventDate) in app/reading/[id]/display.ts returns "Other years with D Month events" exactly when eventsPlacement is "below", using formatLongDate. formatLongDate gives the day via String(Number(day)), so there is no leading zero, and the month as its full name. Otherwise it returns EVENTS_HEADING, "What happened". ReadingView's h2 renders it on both routes and both layouts.
  A grep outside tests finds "What happened" only in EVENTS_HEADING plus two comments. The status label is unchanged.
- R2 Met. unavailableMessage takes the heading as a parameter and quotes it in the linkable-years variant. Both page.tsx files pass eventsHeading with the same events and date they give ReadingView (page.events and page.eventDate; reading.events and reading.event_date), so the quoted heading and the shown heading come from one function with the same inputs.
  The no-linkable variant is unchanged. lib still doesn't import from app.
- R3 Met. The label reads "Pick a different date" and stays htmlFor the input. A grep for "Another date" in app and lib exits 1.
  The one CSS change is phone-only: the picker label gets max-width 100px, so it wraps to three lines and label, input and Go keep one row at 390 (Sprint 52's R3). The handoff records this as the user's decision during the build, after a two-line wrap measured too wide. It is in service of R3 and Sprint 52's R3, and changes the label's wrapping only, not its font, spacing or colour.
- R4 Met. It is still one p with the accuracyNote class: strong lead, one br, then the next step. No CSS was changed for it. The ReadingView test pins one paragraph and one br in both variants.
- R5 Met. Unit tests cover the four cases, including 4 July, 25 November and the single-digit 3 March. The R2 string tests use fixed headings, including the exact 4 July string. Render tests cover both routes, the label and the structure. Sprint 39 and 52 tests are updated and listed.
- R6 Met. I opened other-years-1280-events-reading.png: "Other years with 3 March events" beside "on this day, other years". The message's bold lead ends its line and the next step quotes the same heading. The centred picker panel reads PICK A DIFFERENT DATE.
  I also opened matched-390-events-reading.png ("What happened", this exact date) and picker-panel-390.png (the three-line label beside the input and GO on one row, then OR DISCOVER RANDOM READING below).

Routed to Master Controller:
- Record the user's phone-label decision (the three-line wrap via max-width 100px) in the sprint file or decisions. It also means Go wraps below the input on phones narrower than about 390px (375 and 360 were measured by Dev Team). Sprint 52's R3 only set the 390px bar, so this isn't a failure, but it is a known limit someone may hit.
- Still UNOWNED: /reading/[id]'s "Pick a different date" with no picker on that page, and the 3 lint warnings in the sprint 45 and 46 probe scripts.

No issues found.
commit=71563a7 | ci=green: 1 CI run(s) for 71563a7e1c2118e54b4a40ba72440a60014f7674 all completed successfully with real steps executed.

PASS: PASS (round 1). LiveQA steps 1 to 5 all pass on production. No defects. One layout observation for the user, below. Tested 2026-11-26, about 11:51 to 12:00 UTC, against https://my-little-racoon.vercel.app. Shipped commit 71563a7. Production serves the pushed tip 970bc99: /api/health/db reports status ok, connected true, commit 970bc99, with migrationVersion unchanged at 20261122152710_navigation_exact_date_readings. git diff 71563a7 origin/main touches only docs/sprints/state/sprint-54.json. Tools: headless Chromium (Playwright 1.57) at 1280x900, and 390x900 (isMobile, hasTouch). STEP 1, unmatched date with other years listed: PASS. I used today, /date/2026-11-26, plus /date/2026-11-25, /date/2023-07-04 and /date/2026-07-09, at both widths. - Headings: - /date/2026-11-26: "Other years with 26 November events", status "on this day, other years", 5 rows. - /date/2026-11-25: "Other years with 25 November events". - /date/2023-07-04: "Other years with 4 July events". - /date/2026-07-09: "Other years with 9 July events", a single-digit day with no leading zero. - The reading's message is one

containing lead
next step, with exactly 1 br: - Lead: "We have no recorded events for this exact date, so we can't write an accurate horoscope for it." - Next step: "Pick a different date, or choose one of the years listed under "Other years with 26 November events" to go to that date instead." - The quoted heading matches each page's own heading, for 25 November, 4 July and 9 July likewise. - The line break is real. At 1280 the lead's glyphs end at y 554 and the next step's begin at 561. At 390, 718 and then 724. That's the next line, with no extra gap. - The p has margin-bottom 0px and max-width none; font 19px/29.45px at 1280 and 17px/26.35px at 390. - No other h2 on these pages reads "What happened". - Screenshots: s54-1280_date_2026_11_26.png and s54-390_date_2026_11_26.png. STEP 2, /date/1969-07-20: PASS. The heading is "What happened", status "this exact date", at both widths. The matched reading /reading/0b01c79f-73d5-4fbc-afeb-d65da32ae38d also reads "What happened". STEP 3, the picker panel: PASS at both widths. - The label reads "Pick a different date", with htmlFor "date-page-picker", the date input. - Panel text: "PICK A DIFFERENT DATE GO OR DISCOVER RANDOM READING". "Another date" appears nowhere in the page text. - Located by its label (getByLabel "Pick a different date"), the input filled with 1912-04-15 plus Go lands on /date/1912-04-15. Screenshots: s54-1280-panel.png and s54-390-panel.png. STEP 4, an unmatched reading: FOUND. /reading/9bd536d1-243f-49e7-8c59-af75b6d76067 shows "Other years with 21 July events", status "on this day, other years", 5 rows. Its message quotes "Other years with 21 July events", with the same strong-br structure, at both widths. STEP 5, at 390: PASS. scrollWidth is 390 on every page. The heading wraps cleanly to 2 lines, "Other years with 26 / November events" (heading box x 32-243, status 243-358, no overlap). Screenshot: s54-390_date_2026_11_26.png. OBSERVATION, not a defect, for the user to judge. At 1280 the longer heading also wraps: - "Other years with 26 November / events", with "events" alone on the second line (heading box x 673-1003); - the status beside it wraps to 2 lines, "ON THIS DAY, OTHER / YEARS" (box 1003-1167). Before this sprint it was one line. Nothing overlaps or scrolls, and no requirement asks for a single line. Shorter dates (4 July: heading 673-957) still wrap the status. Screenshot: s54-1280_date_2026_11_26.png. 0 console or page errors.
